en.joke: I've started scheduling my existential dread. It really helps with time management.
en.explanation: It's funny because it takes a profound, overwhelming emotion (existential dread) and applies a mundane, modern coping mechanism (scheduling), highlighting absurd attempts to control inner chaos.

people.name: Salvatore Maranzano
people.extract: Salvatore Maranzano, nicknamed Little Caesar, was an Italian-American mobster from the town of Castellammare del Golfo, Sicily, and an early Cosa Nostra boss who led what later would become the Bonanno crime family in New York City. He instigated the Castellammarese War in 1930 to seize control of the American Mafia, winning the war after the murder of rival faction head Joe Masseria in April 1931. He then briefly became the Mafia's capo di tutti capi and formed the Five Families in New York City but was murdered on September 10, 1931, on the orders of Charles "Lucky" Luciano, who established the Commission, in which families shared power to prevent future turf wars.
highlights: Early Cosa Nostra boss, led Bonanno crime family.
Instigated Castellammarese War, became capo di tutti capi.
Formed the Five Families in New York City.

people.name: Derek Smith (ice hockey, born 1954)
people.extract: Derek Robert Smith is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player who played in the National Hockey League with the Buffalo Sabres and Detroit Red Wings between 1975 and 1983. He was selected by the Sabres in the 1974 NHL Amateur Draft.
highlights: Canadian former professional ice hockey player.
Played in NHL with Buffalo Sabres.
Also played for Detroit Red Wings.

people.name: John Swainson
people.extract: John Burley Swainson was a Canadian-American politician and jurist who served as the 42nd governor of Michigan from 1961 to 1963.
